1. August 2025 — Present

    Teaching assistant

    Software Engineering I · FIUBA

    I guide students through API design, testing, project management, and software development.

    14 students per semester, across two teams of 7.

narrative.overview:
An open engineering folio pairs a cool gray marginal index with nearly white reading sheets. Condensed title blocks establish identity; Geist prose and small technical metadata keep the evidence readable. Restrained blue marks destinations, focus and small annotations rather than broad color fields.

The system is square-cut and flat: ruled capability rows, a silver-logo carousel on Home, a text-only project ledger, text-led biography and an academic timeline. All six project preview images and their data references were removed at the owner's request. Home and About have no visible portrait. Product facts remain in `PRODUCT.md`; route strategy remains in `.impeccable/surface-home.md`.
keyCharacteristics: A fixed desktop marginal index becomes a two-row in-flow header on smaller screens.
Barlow Condensed titles and capability lists contrast with Geist prose and metadata.
Open skills rows lead into a silver-logo carousel; Projects presents all six projects in a text-only ledger.
Blue interaction annotations move without hiding or moving the evidence itself.

rules.name: The Restrained Accent Rule
rules.body: Keep broad regions paper or neutral gray; reserve blue for actions, focus and small annotations.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Use Barlow Condensed for identity, headings and prominent capability lists; use Geist for prose, navigation, actions and technical metadata.

rules.name: The Flat Evidence Rule
rules.body: Present project evidence through descriptions, technology lists and direct source links, using fine rules and open space.

dos: Do preserve paper and gray fields with restrained blue actions and focus.
Do pair Barlow Condensed identity and capability lists with Geist prose and metadata.
Do retain text-led project rows, source links and open ruled ledgers.
Do provide equivalent hover/focus annotation and immediate reduced-motion states.
donts: Don't restore the outgoing Manrope card system as the current visual authority.
Don't enlarge one selected project into a dominant featured treatment.
Don't replace original project evidence with invented artwork or claims.
Don't promote compatibility variables, development overlays or synthesized palette steps into shipping variants.
